note: Display text for the '검증 기록' table of the method tab, fold 04 (scripts/build_posthoc_scorecard.py). The results themselves come from posthoc.validation_sets of dist/assessments.json and are never restated here; this file only names each check in Korean, says whether its criterion was fixed before the run, what was done after a check that did not pass, and which stored numbers of its record file the table quotes (figure: paths into the first record JSON; the build reads the values there, this file holds none). Nothing here enters a score, a type or the map. registered: checks whose criteria are committed before any result (a pre-registration file and the commit that added it alone); each becomes a row of its own until its result is stored in posthoc.validation_sets.
outcome_rule: result consistent_same_data or reproduced_n2 -> 일관성 확인(독립 아님): the check reads the same data the score is made from (KOSIS catch; IUCN categories), or two species only
result failed and after_failure.action removed -> 실패 후 사용 중단
result failed and fewer evaluable cases than the minimum the criterion fixed before the run (min_sample) -> 검증 불성립

indicator_badges.rule: An indicator with a passed check reads '검증 통과'; otherwise one with a same-data or two-species consistency check reads '제한적 확인'; otherwise '검증 미통과'.
